evidence: Article 15(3): "The braking system of towed vehicles (excluding towed vehicles with a gross vehicle weight of 0.75 tonnes or less) shall be structured to meet the following standards"; (3)(3): "The braking system of the towed vehicle shall be structured to automatically stop the towed vehicle when the coupling between the towing and towed vehicle is disconnected while in motion." Current categories omit trailers despite express towed-vehicle requirements.

Article 18 lists only: "All electrical wiring of the vehicle shall be covered with insulating material and fixed to the vehicle body"; "Electrical terminals and electrical switches inside the passenger compartment shall be appropriately covered with insulating material"; and "The battery shall be fixed so that it is not loosened or damaged by vehicle vibration or shock". These are insulation, fastening and battery safety requirements, not electromagnetic compatibility requirements.

Article 15-2(2)(2)(c) excludes ESC operation "During self-diagnosis at startup" and (2)(4) requires "a warning lamp that illuminates when a fault occurs". This is ESC diagnosis and warning, not emission-related on-board diagnostics. The article regulates ESC braking control and never establishes OBD requirements.
